Firecrawl is a web data platform that turns websites into LLM-ready data. Its API can convert URLs into LLM-ready markdown or structured data with a single API call. Its offerings include Scrape, which extracts LLM-ready data from websites in formats like Markdown, JSON, and screenshots; Search, which searches the web and retrieves full content from results; and Crawl, which crawls all pages on a website and collects data for each page. It also has Extract and Map endpoints.

The company grew out of an earlier product. Previously, the team built Mendable, one of the first commercially available "chat with your data" applications. Firecrawl is a Y Combinator company (S22 batch, per the job listing).

The founders named in the results are:
- **Caleb Peffer**, co-founder and CEO. He co-founded Mendable.ai and previously established Churnkey, a software company ultimately acquired by Paddle.
- **Eric Ciarla**, co-founder. He co-founded Mendable in March 2022, and one source lists his role as Chief Marketing Officer.
- **Nicolas Silberstein Camara**, founder and CTO according to one profile.

Sources disagree on funding. Seedtable lists a Series A of $14.5M dated 19 Aug 2025. Dealroom instead reports a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital in September 2026, which I could not verify against another source. Founding year is generally given as 2022, though one listing says Firecrawl pivoted in early 2024 to focus on web scraping APIs for large language models.

content.text:
**What Firecrawl does:** Firecrawl is a web data platform that turns websites into data that LLMs can use. One API call can convert a URL into clean markdown or structured data. Its main endpoints are:
- **Scrape:** pulls LLM-ready data from a page as markdown, JSON or screenshots.
- **Crawl:** collects data from every page of a site.
- **Search:** searches the web and returns the full content of the results.
- **Extract and Map:** structured extraction, and mapping a site's URLs.

**Who founded it:** The founders named in the results are:
- **Caleb Peffer**, co-founder and CEO. He also co-founded Mendable and earlier founded Churnkey, which Paddle acquired.
- **Eric Ciarla**, co-founder. He co-founded Mendable in March 2022, and one source lists him as CMO.
- **Nicolas Silberstein Camara**, listed as co-founder and CTO in one profile.

**Background:** Firecrawl grew out of Mendable, an early "chat with your data" product. It is a Y Combinator company (S22 batch). One listing says it pivoted in early 2024 to web-scraping APIs for LLMs.

**Funding:** The sources disagree. Seedtable lists a $14.5M Series A in August 2025. Dealroom reports a $75M Series B led by Smash Capital in September 2026. I couldn't confirm that second figure against another source.

Sources:

- [Caleb Peffer – Startup Intros](https://startupintros.com/people/caleb-peffer)
